high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from moneycontrol.com, displaying an article about Waymo's progress in the ride-sharing market. The text is written in English and discusses Waymo's rapid growth in San Francisco, where its share of the ride-share market has increased significantly within 20 months, reaching an estimated 27 percent by April 2025. The article mentions that Waymo's self-driving service now earns more money in gross bookings than Lyft and is projected to surpass Uber within the next 12 months.
